plainTranslation: Their Neptune in your 7th house: idealized partnership - you see a dream of who they could be as your person. Romantic and unclear. Failure mode: committing to the fantasy and missing the real terms. Love who's actually there; check the partnership against reality.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
